name: CYT (55, 8-byte frames): any car (raw messages)
description: CYT box with 8-byte frames: 55 D0..D5 AA from the box (no length, no checksum, AA at the end; the message's command is 55), 55 CMD LEN data CS to it (CS = (CMD + LEN + data) xor FF). Read from Car Info's decoders CytBydF3Protocol and CytBydS6LowProtocol (their deframer, parsePacket). No acknowledgement. Any car: no decoding, raw messages. Also the description of this box type ("box": "cyt-55-fixed").
